prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, preferably 1600x900 or larger. All text must be accurate Japanese. This is a fresh original illustration, not a photo composite.
Approved style reference already viewed: B-culver-black-lime-v3.png. Match its charcoal black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm off-white, thick Japanese headline lettering, rough hand-ink and dry-brush textures, few bold elements, striking editorial sports poster feel. Do NOT reuse the reference's player, date, name, score, or other article-specific content.
Subject identity: ONE real adult current basketball player, Kento Akama / 赤間賢人 of Ibaraki Robots. His official 2026-27 portrait has been viewed: medium-short dark brown hair with rounded voluminous bowl silhouette and dense gently side-swept fringe, compact oval face and softly rounded jaw/chin, straight fairly dark eyebrows, narrow almond eyes, straight nose with rounded tip, full lips, clean-shaven youthful 21-year-old Japanese man, lean athletic shoulders. Closely preserve these observed facial features, not a generic invented athlete. Use the viewed official portrait ONLY to guide identity, never paste or reproduce the official photograph, its pose, logos or jersey print.
Draw Akama in expressive monochrome ink with subtle warm skin and hair tones, in an energetic low forward-driving dribble pose, slight three-quarter face visible looking forward, body angled diagonally. One hand naturally controls an orange basketball at hip height, the other arm balances the motion. Two coherent arms, natural wrists, five anatomically plausible fingers on each hand; don't obscure the face. Plain sleeveless unbranded jersey and shorts, no lettering, no numbers, no team logo, no league logo, no sponsors. Waist-to-mid-thigh editorial framing is fine, but keep head, hands, ball and important action wholly inside the canvas with padding. This is an imagined basketball motion, NOT a depiction of an actual game moment and NOT a claim of his appearance or performance on this date. No opponents, crowd, scoreboard or fabricated results.
Composition: athlete on the LEFT 45 percent, strong diagonal lime brush movement behind him; big clear type on the RIGHT 55 percent. Spacious and crisp text area, no overlap between face/arms and words. Leave about 5 percent margin all around; bottom qualifiers get their own calm dark area. Avoid small illegible microtype. Make the main headline dominate the right half, with short clear hierarchy, while keeping the face large enough to recognize.
Exact visible text, and no other text:
small top-right masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
date, medium bold: 「2026.11.09」
very large bold headline: 「試合予定」
lime subheadline: 「B.PREMIER 全6試合」
readable qualifier: 「当日TOP3は公式記録確定後」
small but clearly readable timestamp: 「11/09 00:54 JST時点」
bottom footer, clearly readable: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」
Do not print the player's name. Do not print personal statistics, BEST 5, player rankings, guaranteed participation, a victory, an outcome or exact game scene. Text is grounded solely in the frozen manuscript: six B.PREMIER games on 2026-11-09, all pregame as of 00:54 JST, with daily TOP3 awaiting all official records. Do not add information beyond this. No photorealism, no official photo pixels, no logos, no badges, no watermarks.
prompt.correction:
Edit the FIRST input image, the finished Japanese basketball thumbnail. This is the one allowed correction, so carefully fix the composition while preserving all its accurate content. Input 1 is the edit target; input 2 is the official portrait of the subject Kento Akama, used ONLY as identity reference, never as a photo insert; input 3 is the approved black/lime ink illustration style reference, used ONLY for illustration style.
Keep the output 1672x941 or a similar 16:9 landscape at least 1000px wide.
Required correction: shrink and reposition the athlete in the LEFT 43% so his entire rounded hair silhouette has at least 45px dark margin above, the complete orange basketball has at least 45px margin at the left edge, and ALL fingertips of his basketball hand are fully on-canvas. His other hand must also be completely visible. His lower thighs may be editorially cropped by the bottom edge, but no head, hand, finger or ball may be clipped. Use a low athletic dribble with a clearly visible three-quarter face, two coherent arms, natural fingers and wrists. Give each hand exactly five anatomically plausible fingers. Slightly reduce and inset the text block as needed so every character and lime banner sits at least 35px away from the right edge. No overlap with the athlete.
Identity refinement: closely use the SECOND reference's face and hair. Kento Akama has a smooth rounded dark-brown bowl-cut silhouette with dense straight gently swept fringe, NOT messy windswept waves, a compact oval face, narrow almond-shaped eyes, straight brows, a rounded nose tip, full lips, soft rounded jaw/chin and no facial hair. Keep him recognizable and youthful, an adult age 21. The hair should fall in a rounded smooth shape across the forehead, not expose a middle part. Repaint in clearly hand-drawn ink with bold brush marks like the approved THIRD reference, not photorealism. The uniform is plain and completely unbranded, no numbers, no logos, no sponsors. Do not copy any photo pixels.
Preserve charcoal #151A18 and lime #CCF43B, cream type, orange basketball and hand-ink dry-brush character. Preserve the LEFT athlete / RIGHT text layout and the exact visible Japanese text already in the first image:
バスケまとめ
2026.11.09
試合予定
B.PREMIER 全6試合
当日TOP3は公式記録確定後
11/09 00:54 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ
No player name, no stats, no additional text, no scoreboard, no new person. This remains an imagined basketball dribbling illustration, never an assertion of actual game participation or events. No logos, no official photographs, no photorealistic rendering. Output ONE corrected finished thumbnail.
